content.value_statement: Revenue teams lose pipeline quality when lead stages, scoring, routing, and handoffs are unclear. This skill turns RevOps problems into practical CRM processes, automation plans, and dashboard guidance.
actual_capabilities: Defines lifecycle stages from subscriber through customer and evangelist.
Builds lead scoring models using fit, engagement, product usage, and negative signals.
Designs routing rules for territories, round-robin queues, named accounts, and SLA escalation.
Outlines CRM automation workflows for HubSpot, Salesforce, scheduling tools, and Zapier patterns.
Creates pipeline hygiene plans with stage criteria, stale deal controls, and dashboard metrics.
Recommends RevOps implementation documents that teams can adapt for their CRM.
limitations: Does not connect directly to CRM, calendar, enrichment, or automation platforms.
Does not replace legal, privacy, or compliance review for customer data handling.
Requires user-provided business context for accurate thresholds and routing rules.
Does not write cold outreach copy; it points those requests to a dedicated cold email skill.

use_cases.title: Align Lead Lifecycle Definitions
use_cases.description: Create shared MQL, SQL, opportunity, and recycling rules for marketing and sales teams.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Sales Follow-Up
use_cases.description: Design lead scoring and routing rules so sales works the highest intent leads first.

use_cases.title: Clean Pipeline Reporting
use_cases.description: Define pipeline stages, required fields, stale deal alerts, and leadership dashboard metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Define Lifecycle Stages
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a team without shared lead definitions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help us define lead lifecycle stages for a B2B SaaS team. We use HubSpot, sell to mid-market accounts, and need clear handoff rules between marketing and sales.

prompt_templates.title: Create Lead Scoring
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate scoring model for sales prioritization.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a lead scoring model for our enterprise software business. Our ACV is over $50K, and sales needs clear fit, engagement, and negative scoring signals.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Pipeline Hygiene
prompt_templates.prompt: Our deals stay in stages too long, required fields are missing, and forecasts are unreliable. Create a pipeline hygiene plan with CRM automation and dashboard metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Design Full RevOps System
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced operating model across scoring, routing, automation, and reporting.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an end-to-end RevOps operating system for a sales-led B2B company. Include lifecycle definitions, scoring, routing, SLAs, automation workflows, and executive dashboard metrics.

output_examples.input: We need a shared MQL definition for HubSpot.
output_examples.output: A lifecycle stage document with entry criteria, exit criteria, owner, SLA, rejection reasons, recycling rules, and HubSpot implementation notes.

output_examples.input: Sales needs to know which enterprise leads to call first.
output_examples.output: A scoring model that weights firmographic fit, authority signals, intent actions, product usage, disqualifiers, thresholds, and routing actions.

output_examples.input: Leadership wants a reliable pipeline dashboard.
output_examples.output: A dashboard plan covering funnel conversion, win rate, sales cycle length, pipeline velocity, coverage ratio, stale deals, and review cadence.

best_practices: Provide CRM, ACV, sales cycle, lead volume, and current handoff rules before asking for a design.
Validate scoring thresholds against real closed-won and closed-lost data before automation goes live.
Review lifecycle definitions and routing rules with marketing, sales, and customer success owners.
anti_patterns: Do not automate lifecycle stages before teams agree on stage definitions and ownership.
Do not route every lead the same way when territories, named accounts, or intent levels differ.
Do not treat dashboards as accurate when required CRM fields and stage rules are not enforced.

faq.question: What does this RevOps skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps design lead lifecycle stages, scoring models, routing rules, CRM workflows, pipeline hygiene, and revenue dashboards.

faq.question: Can it configure my CRM directly?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation plans and platform-specific guidance, but users must configure systems themselves.

faq.question: Which CRM platforms does it reference?
faq.answer: It includes guidance for HubSpot and Salesforce, plus patterns for Calendly, SavvyCal, Zapier, and enrichment tools.

faq.question: Does it write sales emails?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on systems and processes. Cold outreach copy should use a dedicated cold email workflow.

faq.question: What context should I provide?
faq.answer: Share your GTM motion, ACV, CRM, sales cycle, lead volume, current stages, pain points, and business goals.

faq.question: Can it support both PLG and sales-led motions?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes templates for product-led, enterprise sales-led, and mid-market hybrid revenue motions.
